description.narrative: Stöd till a) Införande av ett Energiledningssystem i en pilotkommun och stöd till energieffektivisering och förnybar energi i flerfamiljshus, och b) Analys av möjligheter till utvecklande av en nationell model för uppskalning och replikering.

Support to a) Establishment of an Energy Management System in a pilot Municipality and support to energy efficiency and renewable energy measures, and b) Analyzing the possiblities for upscaling the model on the national level.

The project is designed in the context of agreed strategic priorities for supporting development outcomes in Armenia. This project directly responds to the need to progress to adjust transition to low carbon development in Armenia with involvement of communities in implementation of stated objectives under Paris Agreement, integrating poverty alleviation efforts with climate action to address the multidimensional aspects of poverty in Armenia.
Project's overall objective: Enhance the economic, environmental, and social resilience of an secondary town/municipality in Armenia by developing, piloting and scaling a model for economic empowerment and low carbon development that can be replicated in other communities of the country.
The expected project outcomes are: 1. A proven model of energy efficiency (EE) and renewable energy (RE) for replication and accelerated impact. 2. Reduction in the carbon dioxide emissions due to the implemented measures over time. 3. Support to stronger economy, stronger connectivity and crosscutting deliverables.

description.narrative:
The project achieved many results, among them:
UNDP has initiated involvement of an energy management system (EMS) expert who was tasked with assessment of the status of energy performance and management of community owned buildings and systematic knowledge transfer, including delivering trainings for enhancing local capacities and setting up a platform for a consolidated EMS methodology adoption.
The data of energy consumption of community public facilities in all settlements is collected and database is created to enhance local capacities and setting up a platform for a consolidated EMS methodology application. With support of the government in 10 PV systems were installed in public buildings with total nominal capacity of around 160 kW.
The Sociological survey (SS) was conducted in Alaverdi among the residents of the thermally insulated and potential beneficiary buildings for assessment of the opinion of residents on energy efficiency measures impact and benefits. The majority of beneficiaries (93%) are fully or somewhat satisfied with the outcome of energy efficiency modernization measures. UNDP hired an expert for development of energy efficiency (EE) and Renewable Energy (RE) technologies training curricula and program for Alaverdi State Vocational College (ASVC).
The expert conducted training of trainers (ToT) for the ASVC selected staff, outlining the technicalities and informational guidelines for the delivery of educational program. Projects funded renovation of 9 residential buildings, from which 2 for full and 7 for partial EE refurbishment. The roofs were repaired and windows and doors were installed. The external walls insulation were completed. Full thermal weatherisation of 2 concrete panel 9 story buildings, with a total number of 72 apartments ensured approximately 50% energy saving.
Also, one public building prioritized by community (Kindergarten No. 6) and, as well as 27 multi apartment residential buildings were identified and selected for energy efficiency rehabilitation (reconstruction of roofs, insulation of attic floors, replacement of doors and windows in the entrances and installation of LED lights, renovation of entrances were considered, as result of which around 810% energy saving potential was estimated, reducing the leakage from degraded roof cladding.
50 vulnerable households were selected for the installation of Solar Systems.
Preparation of the design documentation for construction of a community managed utility scale solar PV plant with a installed capacity of 500 kW was done. The construction works launched in 2024. The annual revenue of around 20 million AMD from the plant operation will be used to finance sustainable community development and energy efficiency improvement projects.
20 kW rooftop PV systems are being installed in kindergartens No. 2 and No. 7 of Alaverdi. 15 vulnerable households (from selected 50) were assisted with the installation of 2 kW solar PV plants in 2024.
